name: Xray-core
description: High-performance proxy core (VLESS+Reality, VMess, Trojan, ShadowTLS, WARP noise). Runs as a local sidecar service and contributes the "Xray — Xray JSON" rule action: every K.R.O.T. rule gets its own complete Xray config (unlimited rules), which K.R.O.T. renders and manages for you.
author: XTLS

actions.label: Xray — Xray JSON
actions.description: Route matched traffic through the local Xray-core sidecar using this rule's own complete Xray JSON config (its SOCKS inbound port is used automatically).

config.label: Xray JSON
config.description: Complete Xray-core config for this rule. Its SOCKS inbound port is used automatically for the rule's outbound.
